feeds.title: Cosy Home Blog
feeds.description: Cosy Home Blog is an Interior Design and Lifestyle blog, covering topics such as home ideas, crafts, food and drink, and gardening - anything and everything that will help you create your very own Cosy Home. Our team of bloggers is always hot on the heels of the latest home bargains, new ideas, and design classics, and the blog is updated regularly with their shopping finds, baking ideas, garden & craft ideas, and the latest home styling trends, tips, and tricks.

feeds.title: Cozy Little House
feeds.description: I'm Brenda and I blog about frugal and simple living on a budget at Cozy Little House. I also love to write about decorating. I've been rearranging rooms for as long as I've had rooms to rearrange! You can read some of my decorating posts here. I tend to be eclectic in style. I like farmhouse, cottage, and boho-style decorating and tend to mix them up into a sort of 'decorating stew.'

feeds.title: Charming Cozy Home
feeds.description: I'm Vanessa, and I live in the D.C. suburbs with my husband, John, and our four kids. We bought a tiny, old house and have spent years updating it to make it our own. We blog about what we've learned about creating a cozy home on a budget! We give various creative ideas for making small homes work for busy families.

feeds.title: Simple Cozy Charm
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! It is my goal at Simple Cozy Charm to provide you with a catalog of genuine and charming home decorating ideas. My site features inspirational design ideas ranging from cozy farmhouse style to modern eclectic charm. My focus is to bring innovation and new vision to your decorating lifestyle. I continually feature design ideas that I find fun and inspiring from charming DIY to cozy deck and patio decor. Find the ideas of a home, cottage, cozy deck, and DIY decor on Simple Cozy Charm and learn how you can transform your home, Make your home beautiful by reading our blog.

feeds.title: CozyHome Blog
feeds.description: We believe a beautiful kitchen is the secret to a happy home. At CozyHome, we dedicate our time and services to help you make your dream kitchen come true. We are committed to assisting our customers in designing their homes with the best quality kitchen renovations at an affordable price.
